title: The Best Matter Motion and Presence Sensors
subtitle: Motion and presence sensors that work with every major platform.
intro: We pulled the Matter motion and presence sensors selling on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features. Most run Matter over Thread and need a Thread border router; the table shows which.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

buyers_guide.a: PIR sensors detect movement and are cheap with long battery life, but they think a room is empty when you sit still. mmWave presence sensors detect a person sitting still, so lights stay on while you read, but many need wired power.

buyers_guide.q: How long do the batteries last?
buyers_guide.a: Most battery sensors on these lists are rated for one to three years, depending on how often they report. Low-power radios like Zigbee, Z-Wave, and Thread last much longer than Wi-Fi.

buyers_guide.q: Where should I put a motion sensor?
buyers_guide.a: In a corner about 6 to 8 feet up, facing across the room rather than straight at the doorway. Keep PIR sensors away from heat vents and direct sun, which cause false triggers.
